title: Primatial Cathedral of Bogotá

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation on the Plaza de Bolívar immediately west of the cathedral’s front steps.

mapIdentity.scope: The mapped 111-point cathedral outline establishes the west facade and the irregular church body behind it. The distinct Capilla del Sagrario is not part of the plan.

note: The original terrain samples establish the west square as zero and rise toward the rear. The upper tower levels and pediment use the current exact architectural photograph and documented 46 m total height.
